title: Why Is Saving MONEY So Hard for Humans?
title_alternatives: Ancient Humans Had No Money. Why Are We So BAD at It?
Your Stone Age Brain Is Why You Can't Keep MONEY
The 5 Ancient Traps Your Brain Uses Against Your MONEY
Why Your Salary Disappears: The Stone Age ANSWER
Your Brain Is Older Than MONEY
description:
Two out of three adults failed a simple money test. Not because they're stupid, but because the human brain is far older than money. Five ancient traps, from 'right now beats later' to five-thousand-year-old debt, and why they made sense for our ancestors.

This video is history and psychology for education. It is not financial advice.
